locked_decisions.title: dual output tracks
locked_decisions.decision: Parser output must include structured_parse / semantic slots and surface_reading_candidate. structured_parse is primary; surface_reading_candidate is derived display text and must never overwrite slots. literal_component_gloss preserves direct component gloss. Lifecycle is input tokens -> normalized tokens -> structured slots -> semantic resolution -> surface reading candidate.

locked_decisions.title: RH_ACTION plus STRING_NUMBER ambiguity
locked_decisions.decision: RH_ACTION + STRING_NUMBER does not default to VALID_COMPLETE. Without explicit sound-state evidence and without explicit context it is VALID_AMBIGUOUS, carrying open-string and inherited-context interpretation candidates. With explicit open-string evidence or caller no_inherited_context it is VALID_COMPLETE. With valid explicit inherited_context it is VALID_WITH_CONTEXT. If caller declares context_required but does not provide context, the stable status is INCOMPLETE with a missing context requirement.

locked_decisions.title: explicit context only
locked_decisions.decision: P1 implicit_backward_scan_depth is 0. P1 accepts only caller-provided context_ref and inherited_context. P1 may validate compatibility but must not scan previous unit, phrase, line, or arbitrary history. Phrase-level discovery belongs to P5.

locked_decisions.title: D3A guard action enum
locked_decisions.decision: Guard actions are HARD_REJECT, SOFT_PENALTY, FORCE_UNRESOLVED, NEEDS_CONTEXT, NEEDS_HUMAN_REVIEW, and NOT_APPLICABLE. Literal forbidden strings are not global bans.

locked_decisions.title: P1-B dual fixture strategy
locked_decisions.decision: P1-B must use abstract fixtures for grammar logic and sanitized real-ID fixtures for D1/D2/normalization integration. Sanitized real-ID fixtures may use atlas component ids but must not carry LXY phrase id, complete reading, source_report, or oracle. P1-A records this handoff only.

corrections_locked.title: input contract invalid status
corrections_locked.decision: INPUT_CONTRACT_INVALID is reserved for schema-level input failures: empty input, required field missing, duplicate token_id, duplicate or invalid sequence_index, invalid field type, malformed component ID, and equivalent contract failures.

corrections_locked.title: unknown fallback only
corrections_locked.decision: PR-UNKNOWN is fallback-only, not eligible for accepted candidates, and UNKNOWN_COMPONENT yields UNRESOLVED review output rather than VALID accepted parse.

corrections_locked.title: generic marker whitelist
corrections_locked.decision: PR-GENERIC-MARKER accepts only registered generic markers with known subtype and explicit behavior. Unknown or semantically unclear generic markers are UNSUPPORTED or UNRESOLVED.
